scope: Software golden vectors only; RTL and synthesis are not implemented
query_center_format: unsigned int16 workspace-relative Q14 xyz; world=(code-32768)/16384
fk_input_format: signed int32 Q24 seven angles (software model internal format)
fk_output_format: unsigned int16 workspace-relative Q14 59 xyz centers

config.rounding: IEEE754 binary32 ingress truncates toward zero to Q14, as source section 6.2.4; integer division nearest ties toward positive infinity; angles same nearest rule
config.overflow: reject out of workspace or unsupported input; explicit capacity status; int64 intermediates within documented bounds
config.notes: Restored user representative-point design, S=4, Q14, 3.125cm fine / 12.5cm coarse grid. No discarded-point bbox or coverage sphere; only coordinate conversion epsilon and derived FK delta. Range culling follows pinned VCC Panda 1.19m. Rake=8/resolution=32 follows pinned VCC validate.hh. Capacities, Q24 angles/Q30 internal FK and budgets remain explicit software-model choices, not finalized user hardware specifications. Previous assistant variant and results are archived and do not measure this profile.
